messages.content: How does the WhatsApp catalogue work?

Think of a BIZORA digital catalogue as a mobile-first, interactive version of your product list, designed specifically to replace bulky, hard-to-read PDFs.

Here is how it works for your customers:

*   **Seamless Browsing:** Your customers open a link on their smartphone and see a clean, organized interface with categories, high-quality images, and specific product details (like sizes, models, or ratings).
*   **Instant Search:** No more scrolling through pages; they can find exactly what they need in seconds.
*   **Direct Inquiry:** Every single product has a dedicated "Enquire on WhatsApp" button. When clicked, it automatically opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message mentioning the specific product title.
*   **Zero Friction:** Your customer doesn't need to download anything or create an account. They simply browse, click, and start a conversation with you.

This setup ensures that even when your staff is busy with in-store clients, your digital storefront is working 24/7 to capture leads.

Would you like to discuss how we can structure your specific product categories? I can set up a brief discovery call with our founder, Shashank, to walk you through the process. You can reach him directly at **+91 8147827430** or [click here to chat on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/918147827430).

Regarding **Digital Catalogues & Online Presence**:

- Description: Interactive online product catalogues that replace heavy 40MB PDF files that customers rarely open or struggle to read on mobile.
- Key Capabilities: Category-based product browsing, instant search, product photos, variant specs (sizes, models, ratings), and a direct "Enquire on WhatsApp for this Product" button for every item.
- Customer Experience: Customers browse smoothly on their smartphone and send instant WhatsApp messages with the exact product title prefilled.
- Ideal For: Battery & electronics stores, hardware distributors, industrial component suppliers, furniture showrooms, clothing and lifestyle boutiques.
- Delivery Timeline: 7 to 14 business days depending on the number of categories and items.
